facts.text: Caroline felt proud and grateful during an event where she experienced a strong sense of community and acceptance.

evidence.quote: I felt so proud and grateful - the vibes were amazing and it was comforting to know I'm not alone and have a great community around me.
Being around people who embrace and back me up is beyond words. It really inspired me.

facts.text: Caroline described the experience as being around people who accepted and celebrated her, which made her feel accepted and happy.

evidence.quote: I felt so accepted and happy, just being around people who accepted and celebrated me.
How did it make you feel?

facts.text: Caroline mentioned that realizing she could be herself without fear and having the courage to transition was the best part of the experience.

evidence.quote: Realizing I can be me without fear and having the courage to transition was the best part. It's so freeing to express myself authentically and have people back me up.
You've found the courage to be yourself - that's important for our mental health and finding peace.
